verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on the WorkOS workspace, managing organizations, connections, users, and branding, secured via AuthKit as an OAuth authorization server. This is corroborated by a direct probe confirming the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of connecting an agent to the MCP server (only first-party docs and a probe, no third-party usage reports).
